Karnataka Special Sweet Kesari Bath, Semolina halwa or sheera with saffron milk or turmeric milk used for the Kesari -Orangish yellow color. Semolina is roasted in ghee, cooked by adding water, ghee, sugar, cardamom powder, cashew and raisins.

ImageDescription.value: Rice pudding also called payasam in Kerala is made of rice,sugar and milk.Dry fruits are used for garnishing.It is an important sweet dish during festivals like Onam and Vishu.

Categories.value: Payasam|People of Kozhikode|Malayalam screenwriters

ImageDescription.value:
Kozhikode-based Salafi preacher recently described non-Islamic festivities like Onam and Christman as "haram", asking Muslims to refrain from participating in these celebrations.

In response, a young Muslim activist in Kerala held his very own 'Payasam' fest to celebrate the harvest festival of Onam. Not only that, some 200 people came forward to attend his fest and enjoy the sweetened rice dessert.

"My smiling Onam wishes. I declare openly that if my religion would vanish by celebrating festivals, let it go," read writer-cum-activist Fais Umer's banner inviting people.

ImageDescription.value: This payasam or kheer is specially made in certain region of Tamil Nadu. This recipe is made with kauni arisi or known as black rice. Recipes made with this rice is mostly made in chettinad regions (places surrounding Karaikudi) and people who belongs there. This rice has many benefits when consumed which also includes weight loss.
